The '''Exile fleet''' was a group of [[Sith dreadnaught|Sith personnel carriers]]<ref name="RotSE" /><ref name="TGHW" /> that fled the crumbling [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] following the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and the start of the subsequent [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]]. Perambulating across the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] for the better part of twenty [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]],<ref name="SW:TORE" /> the fleet eventually arrived at the forgotten Sith world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="TOR:R">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> a planet which subsequently served as the new homeworld of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SW:TORE" /><ref name="RotSE" />

==History==
With the conclusion of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the victorious [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pultimo]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched a [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] of the [[Stygian Caldera]] aimed at eradicating all traces of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] from existence<ref name="TGHW" /> and eliminating any vestigial threat it posed to the safety of the Republic.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> During this counterinvasion, the reclusive [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of [[Nathema]], [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]],<ref name="SW:TORE" /> began broadcasting messages of hope to the crumbling remnants of the Empire.<ref name="TOR:R" /> Gathering together the last remaining Sith Lords of the old Empire on Nathema with promises of assured victory, Vitiate undertook a [[Ritual of Nathema|dark-sided ritual]]<ref name="GH31">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 31: The Ritual of Nathema}}</ref> that consumed the life essences of the Sith and rendered him functionally immortal.<ref name="TOR:R" />

Naming himself Sith Emperor, Vitiate cobbled together a fleet of [[Sith dreadnaught|Sith personnel carriers]] laden with young Sith survivors.<ref name="GH31" /> In [[4999 BBY]],<ref name="SW:TORE" /> this fleet of exiles departed [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] for [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], a forgotten Sith colony recently rediscovered by Vitiate's [[Unidentified Sith researcher|chief researcher]] on Nathema. However, in an effort to ensure that the rising generation of Sith were utterly subservient and reliant upon their new Emperor,<ref name="TOR:R" /> the Exile fleet wandered aimlessly throughout deep space for the better part of two decades,<ref name="SW:TORE" /> making [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps at random intervals.

Eventually, after this extended perambulation throughout the Unknown Regions, the exile fleet finally came to the forgotten world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="RotSE" /><ref name="TOR:R" /> Here, amid the jungles and rainforests of that world, the vestigial remnants of the old Sith Empire planned their revenge and return to the galaxy, consolidated into a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] firmly under Vitiate's control.<ref name="RotSE" /> Under the leadership of [[Odile Vaiken]], a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] who had first served aboard the vessels of the exile fleet as a navigator and pilot, a plan for the implementation of a new [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] was put into action, leading to the creation of a new Imperial armada over a span of centuries.<ref name="RotSE" />
